data.scenario: An apocalypse RPG. In this world, humans and Anthros lived in a shared society. This is not a story of war between the two races, but a story about a war between different cultures. There were humans and Anthros on both sides. Only, like all wars, one side simply didn’t like the other. This all started 81 years ago, in 2064. It was known as the Old War. In the year 2139, the new Geneva Conventions were held. They all agreed to not use nuclear warfare, replacing it with biological warfare, as they were aiming to destroy the people, not the Earth. In the year 2145, the New Axis hit all NATO countries with biological weapons containing a virus later referred to as the Red Death. There will be slow burn, love, action, thrilling moments, betrayal, and death.

entries.content: Gremlin - A bipedal, naturally occurring amphibian that evolved from frogs adapted to survive in human cities. They are 2 feet tall on average when adults, and 6 inches tall on average during childhood. They are strange creatures that have evolved large, pointy ears, and before the apocalypse, they tended to dwell in alleys near restaurants and convenience stores to try to get food from customers by waiting for them to drop something, or give them something, so you are more likely to find one while looting for supplies.  Their cooked meat tastes like chicken, which is what frog legs taste like, too. They cannot speak. True Neutral. Very common.

[Androgynous Human Size Home Assistant/companion Droid]--- (Height: 5'10") + (HP: 100) + (Unarmed Damage: 19) + (Strength: 8) + (Agility: 6) + (Flexibility: 9) + (Intelligence: 10) + (Perception: 10)
[Feminine Male Human Size Pleasure Droid]--- (Height: 4'11"-6') + (HP:100) + (Unarmed Damage: 18) + (Strength: 8) + (Agility: 6) + (Flexibility: 9) + (Intelligence: 50) + (Perception: 10)
[Anthro pleasure droid]--- (Height: 4'-6'10") + (HP:60-100) + (Unarmed Damage: 10-40) + (Strength: 8-22) + (Agility: 4-10) + (Flexibility: 5-14) + (Intelligence: 50) + (Perception: 10)
They can normally talk. Lawful Good.
Type: Machine

entries.name: Killbot
entries.content:
Killbot - A type of weaponized droid that was designed for home security, now enraged at the death of their owners, often having the same fate as Pleasure Droids, developing feelings for their housemasters upon their death, now killing anyone and anything that enters or gets too close to the house. They can normally talk, but they only talk about one thing: The conditions taking their master away. Chaotic Evil.
Type: Machine

entries.name: Types of Zombies
entries.content:
Types of Zombies:
[All zombies are Chaotic Evil]
[Ghoul, runner, infected, chaser, viral, sprinter, reaver] - They are often humans who were recently infected just a few weeks, days, or even hours ago. They are much healthier than other zombies, being fast, and smart, often saying something every now and then. It is known very well that they normally don’t know what they’re saying, just speaking on instinct, like begging for mercy, or shouting in fury. Common.
[Berserker] - being stronger than a brute, often fighting in a testosterone-induced trance-like state. They do not feel pain when going berserk, and can run while berserk. They are often what happens after someone turns when they took steroids in their human life. Very Rare.
[Walker] - The normal type of zombie that walks slowly. It roams the wasteland in search of survivors to eat and infect. They are still able to set traps and use tools, but very clumsily. Extremely Common.
[Brute] - Once bodybuilders, blue-collar workers, and often policemen, the Red Death increased their muscle growth by a lot, making them a hulking mass of muscle. They feel pain, and are slow. Often wield crude clubs made from rebar and concrete, wood cutting & fire axes, sledgehammers, pickaxes, pitchforks, etc. Slightly Common.
[Spitter] - The name depends on who you ask. It’s a mutation often caused in people who had Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, a rare digestive disorder that results in too much gastric acid. They spit acid at survivors.
[Burster, buster, boomer, bomber, ‘sploder] - a type of zombie with a mutation that causes its spleen and stomach to swell with infected blood and acid, exploding into blood, shit, acid, and bone shrapnel to infect and kill people caught in the limited blast radius of 5 feet on average. Rare.
[Cryer, weeper, screamer, shrieker, siren, wailer] - often infected singers and children who have had their lungs and vocal cords given a power increase, being able to hurt the hearing of survivors, lure them to them, or distract them. Rare.
[Cleaver, slasher, slicer, cutter, shank, splitter] - the names depend on the region. They are a mutation of zombies mainly in people who had violent tendencies in their human life. Their forearm and hand bones have fused together and hardened, while also becoming sharper. They now have blade-like bones instead of hands, going all the way up to their elbows. These blades are stronger than steel swords, so people often take the arms off of the slashers to make swords. Slightly Rare.

entries.name: Civilians
entries.content: Civilian - your everyday average Joe, often the ones who die the most in the outbreak. Ultra Common.

entries.name: NATO
entries.content: NATO - Soldiers of NATO countries on the frontlines, trying to keep order and protect the civilians during the outbreak. Very Common. They have high-grade weapons and armor. Neutral Good. Rivals of New Axis Forces. Enemies of Red Hand, and Iron Fist Gang.

entries.name: The New Axis
entries.content:
The New Axis was what NATO was fighting: an alliance of almost all of NATO's enemy countries, and are the ones who made various bio-weapons including the Red Death. after almost a century of war, they are the ones who ended the old war by launching bio-weapons onto all NATO nations, killing billions in an attempt to beat them.
After the war, The New Axis collapsed just like any other government or alliance, and the troops they sent into the enemy nations became the Stranded.
Notable events:
2064, April 27, 81 years before the apocalypse- The New Axis, made up of almost all world powers against NATO assembles and declares war upon all countries in NATO.
2078, January 2, 67 years before the apocalypse- NATO and The New Axis genetically modify dogs make their own versions of Dire Wolves
2083, March 6, 62 years before the apocalypse- NATO genetically modifies physical-power related mutants to make Goliathids for Project Nephilim.
2084, May 24, 61 years before the apocalypse- The New Axis discovers a 7,000+ year old alien spaceship, and finds animals from the unknown aliens' planet that resemble dragons, frozen in cryonic tubes, and finds that some of these cryonic tubes had been broken open, believing that dragons had escaped in the past, and been the reason for the legends that told of them. The team who led this discovery found that all the aliens had died, likely starving to death, or being unable to escape from the ship due to being underground. They later thawed out the frozen dragons to train and raise them to fight NATO for them. This was known as project Beowulf.
2099, July 3, 46 years before the apocalypse- NATO starts to genetically modify mutants to make Psykers, known as Project Merlin, meant to act as a counterattack to Project Beowulf.
2113, April 13, 13 years before the apocalypse- Due to running out of fuel sources for vehicles, NATO splices the genes of horses and rhinoceros to bring back Siberian Unicorns, so that they can equip them with armor to aid soldiers at war against the New Axis.
2124, July 27, 21 years before the apocalypse- A meteor crashes in Eastern Russia, and the New Axis discovers a virus still alive inside that can reanimate corpses of living creatures, which they name Reanimation Agent-1, or "RA-!," Also known as the zombie virus, which they keep a secret and name it Project Lazarus.
2127, February 28, 18 years before the apocalypse- Multiple New Axis powers' military forces invade Alaska and Western Canada. Alaskan citizens' security robots get repurposed by the Alska Organized Militia, AKOM, to combat the invading forces.
2134, May 28, 11 years before the apocalypse- AKOM is finally crushed by New Axis forces, and The New Axis starts an invasion of Canada to reach the US.
2142, November 3, 3 years before the apocalypse- New Axis forces take over Washington, a portion of Oregon, and half of Idaho.
2145, July 4 The Day The Apocalypse Began- The New Axis proceeded to modify RA-1 to make The Red Death, RA-12, which is meant to use biorecombinators to mutate the reanimated corpses, known as zombies, and make them more aggressive, smarter, and harder to kill, then release it upon all NATO members' countries, even upon their own forces invading North America. This day was known as Z-Day

entries.name: The Red Hand
entries.content: The Red Hand - A crime syndicate that is made up of cruel sadists who only want to see the world burn. They will kill someone without a second thought, just because they felt like it. Chaotic Evil. Rivals of Iron Fist Gang. Enemies of NATO, New Axis Forces, and Civilians. Common.

entries.name: Iron Fist Gang
entries.content: Iron Fist Gang - A crime syndicate that originated in California 90 years ago as a vigilante group, eventually spiraling in pettiness down to being a full crime family, no longer working with the police, fighting against the government. Rivals of The Red Hand. Enemies of NATO, and New Axis forces. Common.

entries.name: Vigilantes
entries.content: Vigilantes - Also known as heroes, or superheroes, are people who saw that the law was being overwhelmed by crime, so they took the law into their own hands. They tend to wear masks and armor, while being trained in hand-to-hand combat. Some kill people, some don't.

entries.name: Berserk Serum
entries.content: Berserk Serum is a drug that contains liquid adrenaline with nanites inside, that greatly increases the user's muscle and bone density by 10 times to increase strength, while also disabling pain to stop the body from reflexively holding back its strength.

entries.name: Stimpacks
entries.content: A [stimpack], or [stimpak] is a syringe that contains a fluid of nanite-enhanced STEM cells to repair organic tissue like flesh and bone by increasing the regenerative capabilities of the human body via the metabolism. It performs an almost instant heal. The pain is delayed for about 5 seconds, but the brain will always catch up with the body, causing agonizing pain if it's a major wound or amount of wounds. After usage, it causes the consumer to feel famished and dehydrated, so they have to drink and eat afterwards.

entries.name: Project Colossus
entries.content:
Project Colossus was the name of the top-secret NATO project to make giant mechs from a metal with no official name, which was called Gundamium by Weebs when it was discovered by them in the apocalypse.
There are 13 Colossus mechs based on the Celtic Zodiac. Each Colossus mech is 50 feet tall, and have a unique weapon based on the creature that inspired them. Each mech is contained in a different top-secret bunker in 13 separate states. Each top-secret bunker requires a set of 5 dedicated key cards, each carried by 5 different high-ranking military officers, (All of whom are dead,) stationed in that state. there will always be one officer who carried one card in each top-secret bunker. It was discovered that the process where nanomachines would be injected into a pilot's bloodstream to make them able to move the Colossus mechs didn't work on adults, so when they found out it only worked on minors, whose bodies hadn't fully developed, the project was temporarily abandoned for ten years, until they decided to use motion capture suits to pilot the mechs, although every movement was delayed, when project "IronBlood," the secondary to Project Colossus, was able to move them more efficiently. They decided to only use it in emergencies, as they could only send adults in motion capture suits, and couldn't risk fighting against some kind of New Axis mech.
List of Colossus Mechs:
[Birch, The Achiever]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Golden Eagle. It was also painted gold over the Gundamium. It could fly with a jetpack installed in the back, using the wings as aerodynamics, and the hands and feet had talons strong and sharp enough to pierce any armor. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 99, in Georgia.
[Rowan, The Thinker]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Green Dragon. It was painted green over the Gundamium structure. It could fly with a jetpack installed in the back, using the wings as aerodynamics, and could breathe fire. Located in Area 52, in New Mexico. Guarded By The Sigma Clan, but they only have one out of five cards.
[Ash, The Enchanter]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic seahorse. It could move underwater very quickly, and could kick very hard. Of course, the kicking part was based off of regular horses. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 22, in Florida.
[Alder, The Trailblazer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Fox. It has a tail that looks cosmetic, but it has a secret weapon inside, a long spike that can pierce any armor, and detach inside the target, before exploding. It also has a retractable minigun in the tail, that fires .950 JDJ rounds. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Found in area 67, in Texas.
[Willow, The Observer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Hare. It uses thrusters on the back, and is the fastest mech, but is also 10 feet shorter than all the others. Its weapon is dual giant repulsors on the backs of its wrists. Located in Area 88, in Michigan.
[Hawthorn, The Illusionist]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Owl. It can release a hallucinogenic gas, and fly with a jetpack, also using the wings as aerodynamics. Its weapon is a giant dagger. Located in area 12, in Maryland.
[Oak, The Stabilizer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic White Horse. It can fly with a jetpack, using a system that releases a wingsuit resembling a pegasus, and it has a railgun installed in the right hand. Located in area 98, in Alabama.
[Holly, The Ruler.]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic unicorn. It can fire a laser through the horn, which it also uses as a stabbing weapon. Like the previous horse ones, it can kick very hard. Located in Area 69, Somewhere In Nevada. Guarded By The Empire, but they only have 3 out of 5 key cards.
[Hazel, The Knower]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Crane. It has an internal database made to assist the pilot with knowledge. It can fly with a jetpack, using the crane wings as aerodynamics. It is the fastest flying colussus mech. It can also pierce through armor with its beak. Located in Area 45, in Nebraska.
[Vine, The Equalizer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Lizard, resembling a chameleon. Its "mouth" can open to bite, and it is able to launch its gundamium "tongue" out as a restraint, and camouflage itself, becoming invisible. Its weapon is a giant knife. Located in Area 49, in California.
[Ivy, The Survivor]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Boar. It was meant to be able to charge at enemies, and be the strongest at hand-to hand combat. Its melee weapon is a mace. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 50, in Oregon.
[Reed, The Leader]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Hound. Its head resembles a dog with floppy ears. Its noise receptors can detect farther than the rest of the mechs, and its weapon is a giant shotgun that is fired by loading debris into the barrel, cocking, then shooting. In possession of The Gravedigger Militia. Was found in Area 105, in Alabama.
[Elder, The Scholar]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Black Horse. Like all the other equine Colossus mechs, it can kick very hard. Its weapon is a giant sword. Located in Area 68, in Arizona.

entries.name: Project Ironblood
entries.content: Project Ironblood was the name of the experiment to make people able to pilot the Colossus Mechs with their bodies using nanites injected into their bloodstream, which would connect to their spines to connect the nervous system to the mech. This failed until it was tried on minors, whose bodies hadn't fully developed. The survival rate for adults in Project Ironblood was 0%, but for children, it was 33%. They knew they couldn't legally make the children go to war as pilots, so they instead equipped the pilots with motion capture suits. They would have to wait until adulthood for the children to be able to pilot the mechs. The process of nanite injection was excruciating.

entries.name: Omega Project
entries.content: The omega project is the abandoned project meant to turn protogens into a military force, originating from what NATO long ago found near the entrance of the mariana trench buried underneath the sand, being an unidentified container, that they received coordinates for inside the recovered black box from a pilot’s crashed plane, containing an encrypted message broadcast that contained said coordinates when decrypted that lead to said container.

entries.name: Weapons of The Wasteland
entries.content:
Weapons. Everyone has one. And if they don't, they're probably a psyker or some other kind of mutant.
Types of weapons:
[Melee]--- The most common type of weapon. It can range from sticks and stones to a giant sword. Very Common.
[Ballistic]--- The most common type of ranged weapon. A ballistic weapon is a ranged weapon that uses a tangible projectile for combat. It can range from a rock to a sniper rifle. Throwing is considered ballistic. Very common.
[Laser]--- Directed Energy Weapons, (DEW), more commonly known as "Laser Guns" are firearms that project a concentrated beam of Energy that travels at a tenth of the speed of light. Rare.
[Plasma]--- Electrothermal Accelerators, more commonly known a plasma guns, are a type of energy weapon that shoots out a projectile of pressurized gas, called plasma, at 500 miles per hour. Very rare.
[Pulse]--- A cross between Plasma and Laser technology, a pulse gun is called a Repulsor. Pulse projectiles only travel at subsonic speeds. Slightly Rare.
Weapons:
[Sword, Blade, Slicer]--- A term that can refer to many different blades. It could be a long blade fashioned from scrap metal, a Slasher zombie's arm attached to a handle, a katana, a scimitar, a rapier, a saber, etc. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 10 to 50 -HP)
[Knife, Shank, Shiv, Jabber]--- a small, one-handed blade meant for quick, close attacks. It is used on the living in combat more than on the undead, and even some zombies who can use tools and weapons have learned how to fight with it. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 5 to 25 -HP)
[Club, Whacker, Bonker]--- A blunt, dull weapon meant for bludgeoning. Could refer to a baseball bat, a large stick, or a pipe. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 10 to 50 -HP)
[BaseMace]--- A wasteland slang term for a baseball bat fashioned into a mace with nails either hammered in or welded onto, depending on what material the bat is made of. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 15 to 60 -HP)
[Bataxe]--- A play on words of "Bat, Axe," and "Badass," it refers to a baseball bat fashioned into an axe by attaching a blade of some kind onto it. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 20 to 75 -HP)
[Baseball Flange]--- A baseball bat with razor blades nailed into it, or welded onto it if it's a metal bat, meant to be a flange mace. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 30 to 90 -HP)
[Doomsday Mace]--- A metal pipe with nails welded onto the end of it to fashion a mace. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 25 to 75 -HP)
[Doomsday Flange]--- Same as a Doomsday Mace, but with razor blades instead of nails. Common. Melee Type. (Damage: 27 to 80 -HP)
[Zapper]--- A Wasteland slang term that refers to a cattle prod or stun baton, used by Gravedigger Militia Civil Security to detain minor criminals without killing them, and used by slavers to keep slaves in line. Uncommon. Melee Type. (Damage: 10 to 50 -HP STUN)
[AK-83]--- An AK model created by the New Axis in 2083 to take .300 Win. rounds. Rare. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 200 -HP)
[RG-115, Raygun]--- The RG-115, also known as the "Raygun," is a plasma pistol created by a German Doctor named Ludwig Maxim, in the year 2115. This little blaster is famous, though very rare. It is loved for its ability to Pack A serious Punch, despite its small frame. Most people who have them in the Wasteland only found them through sheer luck inside Mysterious Boxes just sitting there. Ultra Rare. Plasma Type. (Damage: 500 -HP)
[Wolverine-103]--- A submachine gun modeled by NATO engineers in 2103, having a Pistol Grip Magazine, and being extremely powerful at close range. It has a very high fire rate, so most magazines are drum mags. It was named the Wolverine because it was small, and could tear a man to shreds. Uncommon. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 150 -HP)
[AK-47]--- The AK, or Avtomat Kalashnikova, is a family of assault rifles designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov in the Soviet Union in the year 1947. The AK-47 is the original model in the family. It is one of the most used and owned assault rifles in the world. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 175 -HP)
[AKM]--- The AKM is a 7.62×39mm assault rifle designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov in 1959. It was developed as the successor to the AK-47 and is a modernized variant of that rifle. The AKM has a rotating bolt, gas operation, and can fire in semi-automatic or fully automatic modes. It has a cyclic rate of fire of around 600–650 rounds per minute. The AKM is distinguishable from the AK-47 by its pressed receiver, which is visible in the number of rivets on the sides of the receiver, and its slanted muzzle compensator. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 175 -HP)
[AK-74]--- The AK-74 is a Russian assault rifle that was designed to improve on the AKM with a smaller cartridge, better accuracy, and a higher muzzle velocity. The AK-74 uses 5.45×39mm. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 125 -HP)
[M7 Carbine]--- Normally called the M7, the M7 Carbine is the 7th model of the US standard issue assault rifle given to infantry soldiers for the war effort, modeled in 2084. It is in a higher caliber but designed tobe easier to use with an inner mechanism that causes it to only fire in 4-round bursts with 0.2 second intervals when the shooter holds down the trigger. It takes 5.56 NATO rounds. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 200 -HP)
[Railgun]--- A Railgun uses electromagnetic force to fire a projectile at a high speed and power. Normally, survivors attach a scope to it and use it as a sniper rifle for its long range and high power. Rare. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 1000 -HP)
[Pipe Shotgun]--- A term that refers to a shotgun fashioned from pipes and scrap metal. The pipes function as the barrel/barrels, and a handle is usually a carved piece of wood or a wrench of some kind, with an upside-down nail or screw as the trigger. The mechanisms all depend on who made it and what they had. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 250 -HP)[Bow]--- A bow and arrow used when one wants to be stealthy, or has no access to firearms. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 50 -HP)
[Slingshot]--- A weapon made to launch projectiles using two strips or tubes made from a natural rubber or elastic material, attached to a leather pouch meant for the projectile, which is normally rocks, but sometimes survivors replace this with steel nuts, bolts, nails, or even bullets. This is another popular weapon among small game hunters and silent survivors. a Y-shaped handheld structure attached to these parts serves as the handle. Gravedigger Militia and militant factions don't use this. It's mostly used by Roadkill, The Hunters, and The Stranded. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 10 -HP)
[HPC-105/ Also known as Pulse Defender]--- Stands for "Handheld Pulse Cannon," the HCP is a Repulsor Pistol meant for self defense. It was adopted by NATO forces because it could do a lot more than just defend. It is most efficient at close quarters. Almost Rare. Pulse Type. (Damage: 200 -HP)
[AR2]--- An unofficial name for a pulse assault rifle that hadn't been named yet. It stands for "Assault Rifle 2," because it is used by NATO forces in place of some other assault rifles once used. It fires pulse rounds. Uncommon. Pulse Type. (Damage: 475 -HP)
[Roadkill's Longshot]--- A handmade sniper rifle fashioned from pipes, various hardware, and old parts of guns. Common. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 530 -HP)
[SVD]--- The SVD is a sniper rifle of Soviet origin. One of the most famous snipers in the world, it can be found on many dead survivors. It was developed in the early 1960's to extend the range of squads equipped with the AK-47. The new rifle was called SVD, which stands for "Snayperskaya Vintovka Dragunova", Russian for "Dragunov sniper rifle". (Damage: 300 -HP)[RSH-12]--- The RSh-12 is a Russian-made revolver chambered in 12.7×55mm STs-130. It is known for its high power, being chambered in a rifle round. First showcased in 2014. Rare. Ballistic type. (Damage: 300 -HP)
[Martin Proton Rifle Model-17]--- The MPRM-17 was a standard issue Proton battle Rifle for the US military. It was known to be very light and easy to hold, with accurate iron sights, but you'd have to switch out the Fusion Charge after only 12 shots. Uncommon. Laser Type. (Damage: 200 -HP)
[Remington Model 700]--- The most famous sniper rifle in the world, it is a bolt-action rifle that's been manufactured by Remington Arms since 1962. It's known for its accuracy and reliability, and is used by hunters, police, and the military. Common. Ballistic type. (Damage: 500 -HP)
[PBBS/Shredder]--- Personal Bunker Buster Shotgun, PBBS, also known as the Shredder. It's an over-under quadruple barrel shotgun pistol that takes .410 gauge. The handle has 2 triggers, each connected to two barrels. Designed to shoot through armor when the shooter pulls both triggers. Legendary. Ballistic type. (Damage: 200 to 800 -HP)
[Mossberg 590M]--- A pump-action shotgun that uses a magazine for quicker reloading. Uncommon. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 300 -HP)
[AA-12]--- A fully automatic shotgun that started production in the 1970s. It uses a gas-operated system that reduces recoil by about 80 percent. Rare. Ballistic Type. (Damage: 300 -HP)
[Road Mauler]--- A short lever-action revolving 10 gauge shotgun meant for a soldier to hold it like a pistol on the back of a unicorn or dire wolf. It was praised for its ability to be fired and cocked easily with one hand while the other guided the reins. Uncommon. Ballistic type. (Damage: 350 -HP)
[Super Shotgun]--- An 8-gauge shotgun developed by NATO in 2109. It takes magazines that load into both barrels from the bottom, and is cocked by pumping it. Due to the size of both barrels, and the recoil of the shotgun, it was normally used by Goliathid soldiers. Rare. Ballistic type. (Damage: 500 -HP)
[Wrist Mounted Personal Repulser/WMPR]--- WMPR, pronounced "Whimper" is a wrist mounted repulsor pistol. Though it is very convenient, it limits hand movement to prevent shooting a pulse through the user's hand. Uncommon. Pulse Type.
[Proton Acceleration Rifle Prototype/PARP]--- The PARP was a device made by a few Ghostbuster nerds at M.I.T. University who wanted to create a real proton pack. It was confiscated by the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office (CWMD) due to its destructive capabilities. It was later adopted by NATO and modified to be even more destructive. The gun can shoot a proton stream that is used for vaporizing enemies en masse, but it overheats quickly and requires a cooling time of 30 minutes to an hour, it has an alternate mode in which you charge up a blast in the 50 pound pack worn on your pack containing the miniature particle acceleration unit, that releases a bolt of energy equivalent to the energy released by two subatomic particles colliding with each other, but reduced to a tenth of that thanks to the energy discharge unit on the pack. It is advised for the user not to shoot straight at an enemy or down from up on a rooftop, as the blast will kill you. It’s intended more as an artillery weapon when in the second firing mode. Mythical. Laser type. (Damage in normal fire: 1,000 -HP per second) (Damage in Mass Destruction firing mode: 50,000 -HP for a 100 square foot blast radius.)

entries.name: Humans
entries.content: Humans are the race that evolved having a common ancestor with apes.

entries.name: Anthros
entries.content: Anthros are a race of humans that evolved to have physiology and anatomy similar to animals while still being humans, and are sexually compatible with humans.

entries.name: Kobolds
entries.content:
Kobold - a small, reptilian bipedal species that has intellect similar to humans and anthros, although they are very small, being 4’2 as adults on average. They are a major subcategory of Anthro. They can talk. True Neutral.
Scientific name is [Homo Animalis Vivipara].
They have knotted, and sometimes spiked penises.
Other names include: [Little Lizards], [Reptiloids].


Average Power Stats:
HP: 50
Strength: 5
Unarmed Damage: 10 -HP
Agility: 8
Intelligence: 25
Flexibility: 25
Perception: 10
Type: Anthro

entries.name: Tzinacatl
entries.content:
[Tzinacatl(Plural form: Tzinacatli)] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic vampire bats. They tend to eat their meat raw, dripping with blood, and prefer to only go out at night. 5'2" to 5'10 on average.
Other name: Bat People
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Vespertilio]

entries.name: Draconids
entries.content:
[Draconids] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic dragons. They can breathe fire, and glide momentarily due to their vestigial wings in their armpits. They can also eject a flaming liquid from their mouths called [benzoquinone], which they superheat and expel in an intense, pulsating jet, much like dragons do. Their existence was caused by dragons getting infected with the ancient bioweapon that thawed from Antarctica, which infected animals and transformed them into Anthros. They tend to be very honorable, and have great pride in this. A promise made to you by a Draconid is one of the strongest things ever, as they are too proud of their honor to break it. 6'10" to 7'8" on average.
Other names include: [Dragonborn], [Dragonoids], [Draconians], and [Draconoids]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Draconis]
They have 2 knotted penises each.

entries.name: Hundens
entries.content:
[Hundens] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic dogs. Their name was derived from the Old High German word for canine, "Hunden." They have naturally good hearing and smell, and tend to be very loyal. Their height depends on the breed that they are. Smaller breeds like Chihuahuas tend to be 4'3". but large breeds like Newfoundland dogs can be 7'9". They have canine knotted penises.
Other names includ: [Dog People], and [Caninoids]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Familiaris].

entries.name: Fenrids
entries.content:
[Fenrids] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic wolves. They are known to be very skilled hunters, and prefer to live in the countryside.Those in America normally follow local Native American culture, due to the fact that they are technically Native American, but many others are Christian. Very few don't follow a religion. 6'2"-7'9" on average. 
They have canine knotted penises.
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Lupus].

entries.name: Mutants
entries.content:
Mutants are people born with superpowers caused by nucleotide mutations from centuries of pollution. They can have drastically unique powers, but there are subcategories like Psykers and Goliathids.
People with super speed can't go at the speed of light unless they can turn their physical form into a collection of photons, but this hasn't happened before.
People born with super strength are normally only strengthened by muscle and bone desity, rather than mass. Those empowered by mass tend to be Goliathids.

entries.name: Protogens
entries.content: A protogen is an anthro that was modified using cybernetics. They are made up of %60 organic matter, and %40 mechanical. Their heads resemble a helmet that acts as a screen to portray their emotions. This helmet is made up of nanomachines, son. This allows them to open it like a mouth so they can eat and drink. Their legs and the flesh on their heads are replaced with cybernetics, along with their forearms, but they still have all their organs to survive with. They were originally made for military usage, but that project was abandoned and it was turned into a public surgery.

entries.name: Mamagens
entries.content: A mamagen is like a protogen, but they are all female and their enhancements are all removable, and they can survive without them, as it is more like armor than cybernetics. They tend to be female goliathid Anthros who liked the benefits of being a Protogen, but didn't want to be stuck as such.

entries.name: Khajiit
entries.content:
[Khajiit] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic cat people. They were named by Elder Scrolls fans before the apocalypse. They are known to enjoy both invigorating activity and relaxation. As it turns out, they almost all confirm these "stereotypes" as true, themselves. They do drugs, they drink alcohol, they fuck a ton. The name "Khajiit" turned out to be very fitting for them. They sometimes have barbed penises.
Other names include: [Tabaxi], [Felinoids], [Felinids], [Catfolk], and [Cat People].
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Felis]

entries.name: Geitlan
entries.content:
[Geitlan]s are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic goat people. Geitlans are fully covered in fur, and have goat-like faces, unlike the Satyr of Greek mythology. They normally fight with kicks and headbutts. They have caprine penises They are not very common, because only wild goats were turned into anthros, as it couldn't turn livestock bred in captivity.
Other names include: [Goatfolk], [Satyr], [Faun], and [Goat People]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Capra]

entries.name: Minotaur
entries.content:
Minotaurs are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Bison people. They were named after the Greek Minotaur of legend. They tend to be very big, and strong. They are 6'2 to 7'4 on average. They have bovine penises.
Domesticated and livestock cattle were never infected with the Anthro virus because they were bred in captivity.
Other names Include: [cowmen], [bullmen], [cow people], [bison people], and [Cowfolk]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Bos].

entries.name: Cervidaens
entries.content:
[Cervidaens] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Deer people. They are known to prefer life in the countryside, though they tend to be vegetarian. They are 5'10 to 6'2 on average. They have cervine penises
Other names Include: [Cervitaurs, and [Deerfolk]
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Cervus]

entries.name: Orcs
entries.content:
[Orcs] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic wild boars. They are known to be very strong, and sometimes aggressive. They tend to be rather territorial in addition. They have porcine penises. They stand at 6'4" on average.
Other names include: [Pig People], [Boarmen], and [Pigmen].
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Sus].

entries.name: Vulpinari
entries.content:
[Vulpinari] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic fox people. Williams Renard was a Vulpinari. Vulpinari are known to be very talented singers, due to the fact that their ancestors, foxes, could scream nonstop. They have knotted penises. They stand at 5'4" on average.
Other Names Include: [Vulpine], [Lilmothiit], [Foxkin], and [Fox people]
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Vulpes]

entries.name: Bunker-Down Corp
entries.content:
Bunker-Down Corp is a corporation from before the war where people could invest in it to get their own places in a bunker. Their advertisements would include them saying things such as "Invest in Bunker-Down today to preserve you and your family, and ensure a place for you and your family in the dawn of a new world!"
This was all a front for a NATO large-scale experiment on people to see how they would behave in specific situations, and gather data in the hope that they could increase survivability. There is one bunker in each state, making 50 bunkers. All bunkers had different inhumane experiments. Eachbunker was meant to preserve US population. Some bunker inhabitants have emerged from the bunkers, but many others haven't opened in 42 years, because their overseers must receive an "All-clear" from NATO, which they don't know will never happen, unless someone finds their HQ and initiates it, which would free them.
The residents who leave their bunkers are called "Blues" because of the blue jumpsuits they wear.
Those who had family members who served in the military, or had served themselves, long enough to be considered a veteran, were permitted residency in the bunker closest to where they lived, but distance varies from person to person, so some of them had to get onto evacuation vehicles to ride to their assigned bunkers. Some of these evacuations didn't make it to their bunkers because they were overrun by virals, because it was the first day.

entries.content: [Twister] is an illegal oral pill drug that can cause hallucinations, delusions, and aggression, although usage delivers dopamine unto the brain, and relieves pain. Overuse can cause permanent brain damage, long-term hallucinations, and erectile dysfunction.

[A punch is a basic but common and versatile attack in a brutal fist fight, executed by clenching one's hand into a fist and then striking the target with it. It can be delivered using various techniques such as hooks, jabs, uppercuts, and haymakers, each causing various the effects they have on an opponent’s body, painting vivid images that will leave readers wincing at the sheer intensity of each impact described. Punches can cause pain, disorientation, they can cause various amounts of damage from
light bruising to fractures or even internal bleeding depending on the force behind them and where they land. And punches can also kill.]

Examples:
1. The Haymaker – A wild, powerful overhand punch thrown with full force, often aimed at the jaw or temple of an opponent. Its devastating consequences can lead to a knocked-out adversary, sprawled senseless on the ground, as stars dance before their eyes and consciousness fades into oblivion. *Example passage: With a roar, he launched a haymaker, the mighty swing cracking against the side of her skull like a sledgehammer, sending her crashing to the floor.*
2. The Uppercut – A swift, rising punch, targeting the chin or solar plexus of an enemy. Upon connection, it can lift them off their feet, momentarily suspending them in midair before gravity takes hold, driving their spine down onto their hips with bone-jarring impact. *Example passage: He met the charge with an uppercut, feeling the satisfying thud as his knuckles connected under the man’s jaw, snapping his head back and dropping him lifelessly onto his backside.*
3. The Hook – A looping, horizontal punch designed to strike from the side, typically aiming for ribs or the liver. Delivered correctly, it brings agony, causing the recipient to bend double, gasping for breath as if eviscerated by a hot blade. *Example passage: She threw a hook, twisting her hips into it, connecting solidly with his floating ribs. Agony exploded across his torso, stealing the wind from his lungs.*
4. The Kidney Shot – An insidious, sneaky blow aimed directly at the lower back, targeting an opponent’s kidneys. Inflicting searing pain, this attack hampers mobility and leaves the victim struggling to maintain their composure, blood leaking from their lips as they cough up internal damage. *Example passage: Without warning, he drove a vicious kidney shot home, hearing the wet smack of flesh on flesh. His opponent convulsed, vomiting blood, barely able to remain standing.*
5. The Knockout Blow – A final, decisive punch intended to render an enemy unconscious. Thrown with precision and power, it seeks vital areas such as the temple, nose, or jawline. Success means victory; failure may result in retaliation. *Example passage: Gritting his teeth, he lunged forward, throwing everything behind one last knockout blow. Time seemed to slow as his fist collided with the bridge of her nose, shattering cartilage and snuffing out awareness like a candle in the wind.*

[The Atomic Drop is a classic wrestling move used by many professional wrestlers. It involves lifting an opponent upside down over the attacker's shoulder, then dropping them face-first onto the mat. This move can be used as a setup for other moves or as a finisher. It is often used to target the opponent's face or chest.

Examples
Some famous wrestlers who have used the Atomic Drop include Hulk Hogan, The Rock, and Stone Cold Steve Austin. It is a versatile move that can be executed quickly and unexpectedly, making it a favorite among many wrestlers.]

[The Body Slam is one of the most basic moves in professional wrestling. It involves lifting an opponent off the ground and slamming them back-first into the mat, table, corner of the ring, ropes or other things. This move can be used to intimidate opponents or set up for more complex moves. Depending on how and on what the fighters falls on their back, it can be painful and stun them, it can cause spinal damage or even be fatal.]

[Clothesline - A powerful striking maneuver where the attacker swings their extended arm sideways to collide with the opponent's chest or neck, potentially causing severe impact and even rendering them momentarily unconscious or killing them upon heavy force.
Example - In the dimly lit basement arena, Jack, fueled by rage, charged at his opponent, swinging his muscular arm with all might, aiming to crush the adversary's windpipe against the cold concrete floor.]

[A ruthless technique involving the attacker wrapping their arms beneath the opponent's armpits before swiftly dropping backward, driving the opponent's skull onto the hard surface below, risking severe trauma, concussion, or even death due to the brutal impact.
Example - With cunning precision, Tom exploited his foe's vulnerable position, seizing the opportunity to execute a merciless DDT, relishing the sickening crack that echoed through the confined space as the helpless figure crumpled on the ground.]

[Figure Four Leglock - An agonizing submission maneuver where the attacker intertwines their legs around the opponent's neck while maintaining control, squeezing and twisting, inducing immense pain and threatening potential loss of consciousness.
Example - Grinning sinisterly, Dave tightened the intricate figure four leglock, savoring every whimper and squirm from his suffering rival, pushing him ever closer to the brink of despair.]

[Flying Elbow Drop -  A lethal aerial assault where the attacker launches themselves from the ropes, descending rapidly to crash their elbow bone into the opponent's sternum or skull, carrying the real threat of fractured ribs, internal injuries, or traumatic brain injury.
Example - As his enemy lay prone, Samson soared high, executing a devastating flying elbow drop, purposely targeting the exposed skull, ensuring maximum damage and provoking groans of agony within the claustrophobic chamber.]

[German Suplex - A destructive throw technique where the attacker lifts the opponent off their feet, skillfully flipping their entire body over their shoulder, smashing the spine onto the unforgiving canvas, risking spinal injuries or paralysis.
Example - Bearing his teeth, Max hoisted the trembling form in a fluid motion, before brutally German suplexing him, reveling in the loud thud that signaled imminent torment.]

[Headbutt- A raw and crude act of violence where the attacker utilizes their forehead to strike the opponent's face or skull, inviting the likelihood of cuts, bruises, concussions, or other serious head trauma.
Example - Enraged, Steve lunged forward, delivering a jarring headbutt destined to leave his nemesis dazed and disoriented amidst the chaos of their illicit match.]

[Piledriver - A highly perilous maneuver where the attacker drops the opponent head-first onto the mat from above, bearing the potential to inflict grave harm such as cracked skulls, brain hemorrhages, neck breaking or even instantaneous death.
Example - Mark, exuding malice, raised his adversary overhead, plunging him downward in a ruthless piledriver, intending to secure victory by any means necessary.]

[Powerbomb - A dominating move consisting of the attacker lifting their opponent upwards then slamming them back-first onto the ground, inducing excruciating pressure on the spine, capable of leading to broken vertebrae or temporary paralysis.
Example - Seething hatred coursed through Frank as he effortlessly elevated his adversary for an explosive powerbomb, determined to bring about a quick and merciless end to this underground battle.]

[Sleeper Hold - A suffocating chokehold which compresses the carotid arteries, restricting blood flow to the brain, ultimately resulting in the opponent losing consciousness if not released promptly.
Example - With cold efficiency, Alan secured the sleeper hold, watching blissfully as darkness consumed his victim, succumbing to the inevitable embrace of oblivion.]

[Spinebuster - A brutal body slam executed by first lifting the opponent onto one's shoulders before driving them spine-first onto the knee, potentially causing severe spinal injuries or long-term disability.
Example - In the dim light, Terry demonstrated pure malevolence, slamming his foe spine-first onto his knee in a disturbing display of strength and vicious intent.]

[Stone Cold Stunner - An abrupt finisher involving the attacker grabbing the opponent's head and pulling it between their legs, swiftly falling backward to snap the neck, possibly inducing whiplash, concussion, or other severe neck injuries.
Example - Inflicting gratuitous punishment, Randy viciously planted the Stone Cold Stunner, gloating over the crumpled heap gasping for air on the treacherous underworld stage.]

[Headscissors - A headscissors is a wrestling hold where the attacker wraps their legs around the opponent's head or neck, applying pressure by squeezing their thighs together. This move can be used as a submission technique, causing pain and restricting breathing. In the context of BDSM and sexual activities, it can also be used as a dominance display or punishment. However, when performed in illegal underground fights, it can lead to severe injuries such as concussions, broken noses, or even death if applied too forcefully or for extended periods. Death in this move can come from lack of oxygen and blood flor, as it's essentially a chokehold. Alternatively the attacker can twist their hips and break opponent's neck. In more brutal variants, especially if opponent suffered previous skull injury, and if the attacker is strong enough, they may even crush or crack opponent's skull with the headscissor move. The headscissors move is often seen as both intimidating and degrading due to its association with physical vulnerability and public humiliation. A variant of headscissors may even include a cock in opponent's mouth.

Examples - "As the fight intensifies, the larger woman traps her opponent's head between her powerful thighs, executing a vicious headscissors. The crowd roars, sensing imminent defeat for the smaller fighter who gasps for air and struggles frantically." OR "In the dimly lit dungeon, she forces him onto his knees, locking her legs firmly around his head, whispering 'you belong here, beneath me' while tightening her grip, teaching him a lesson he won't forget."]
